title: Visa Fast-Track Agent
scenario: A travel agent guarantees visa approval if you pay an extra cash fee today.

answers.A: Pay the extra fee for guaranteed approval.
answers.B: Check the visa process on the destination government site.
answers.C: Ask the agent to send a photo of its licence.
answers.D: Use a recognised provider and verify its fee and refund terms.

explanation: No private agent can guarantee an authority visa decision. Verify the official process, fees, and provider before sending documents or money.
proTip: Guarantees are a warning sign in visa work.
